interfaceCtat.descricao: Interface FIXA do tutor (a mesma tela para todos os problemas): enunciado; pergunta "What is the fraction in the problem?" com duas caixas numéricas (f1 em cima = numerador, f2 embaixo = denominador); reta numérica de 0 a 2 (numline) onde o aluno marca um ponto, com encaixe em 12 partes por unidade (marcas ocultas), pontos rotulados; botão Hint; botão Done. Os passos do aluno são ações NESSES componentes (digitar nos campos, converter, marcar o ponto, concluir).

dicas.texto: Look for the tray that was filled completely before considering the partly filled tray.
Separate the mixed number into its whole-number part and its fractional part.
The whole-number part counts complete trays, not individual muffin spaces.
Enter the count of trays that were filled all the way in the m1 field.
The mixed number needs its own fields so you can compare the whole part with the fractional part.
Use the control that changes the display from the improper-fraction form to the mixed-number form.
Find the button labeled Convert near the fraction fields.
Click the Convert button once, then check that the m1, m2, and m3 fields appear.
The numerator must count every twelfth-sized part, including the complete tray.
Multiply the number of complete trays by the number of spaces in one tray, then add the filled spaces from the next tray.
Replace the complete tray with twelve twelfths before adding the eleven filled spaces.
Calculate the complete-tray contribution and add the second-tray contribution, then type that total in f1.
A quantity greater than one should be placed to the right of the mark for one.
Use the twelve equal intervals between consecutive whole numbers to locate the fractional part.
Start at 1 and count eleven twelfth-sized intervals toward 2.
Place the point at the final twelfth interval before the mark for 2.
The denominator tells how many equal spaces make one complete tray.
Check that the lower fraction field uses the number of spaces in one tray.
Compare the denominator with the twelve muffin spaces shown in the problem.
Confirm the lower field and the number-line point, then press the Done button.

exercicio.statement:
Jamie is helping her parents bake a very large batch of muffins for a party tomorrow. Jamie's task is to fill the muffin tray with the muffin batter. Each muffin tray makes 12 muffins. Jamie filled one muffin tray completely, but could only fill 11 spaces of the second tray. This means she filled 1 and 11/12 muffin trays. Show this fraction on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem?
